marks.q: Following the launch of an extensive marketing campaign in December 2024, the Company has received a number of promising leads and believes the conversion of its current sales pipeline will lead to a step-change in order flow and revenue generation.
Already in 2025, the Company has secured orders for over 500 Invention Evaluator reports forecast to generate revenues of more than $400k, to complement the existing pipeline of orders.
The Board remains confident that continued investment in GenIP Plc is essential to fostering long-term growth and expansion in 2025 and beyond.

GenIP is in a robust position with clear revenue visibility going into the second half of 2025. Given the typical time lag between order receipt and revenue recognition, we expect an uplift in revenue in H2 2025.

While these efforts have not yet been fully reflected in our financial results, we are confident that the second half of the year will be significantly stronger as we begin to convert our order book into recognised revenues and accelerate delivery of reports.

As anticipated in our half year update, GenIP's performance has strengthened markedly in the second half. Since 30 June 2025, revenue has accelerated as the prepaid orders for AI-powered analytical assessments are delivered to clients.

marks.q: While revenue in the first half reflects the absence of last year's exceptional order, the underlying commercial indicators are positive: a broader client base, deeper engagement with existing customers, and a materially stronger prospect pipeline than at the same point last year.
By internalising our technology stack and reducing third-party dependencies, we expect to improve product margins while gaining greater control over our development roadmap.
